description_en: You can call the GetUser operation to query the details of a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 调用GetUser接口查询RAM用户的详细信息
name: GetUser

parameters.help_en:
The name of the RAM user.

The name is 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的名称。

长度为1~64个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、短划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: user_name

User.description_en: The information about the RAM user

Comments.example: This is a cloud computing engineer.

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the RAM user was created. The time is in UTC

Email.description_en:
The email address of the RAM user.

This parameter is available only on the China site (aliyun.com)
Email.description_zh:
RAM用户的电子邮箱。
该参数仅适用于中国站。

LastLoginDate.description_en: The last time the user logged on with a password. The time is in UTC
LastLoginDate.description_zh: 上次使用密码登录时间（UTC时间）

MobilePhone.description_en:
The mobile phone number of the RAM user.

This parameter is available only on the China site (aliyun.com)
MobilePhone.description_zh:
RAM用户的手机号码。

该参数仅适用于中国站。

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the RAM user was last updated. The time is in UTC

UserId.description_en: The unique ID of the RAM user

UserName.description_en: The name of the RAM user
